#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cctype>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 1000000;
const int dr[4] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
const int dc[4] = {0, -1, 0, 1};

int N, T, Zr, Zc, dist[10][10];
string grid[2][10];

struct Edge {
    int dest, cap, rev;
    Edge(int d, int c, int r) : dest(d), cap(c), rev(r) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge>> flow_net;
vector<int> level, it;

void connect(int u, int v, int c) {
    flow_net[u].emplace_back(v, c, flow_net[v].size());
    flow_net[v].emplace_back(u, 0, flow_net[u].size() - 1);
}

void bfs_level(int src) {
    fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    level[src] = 0;
    q.push(src);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (const auto& e : flow_net[u]) {
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.dest] < 0) {
                level[e.dest] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.dest);
            }
        }
    }
}

int dfs_flow(int u, int sink, int f) {
    if (u == sink) return f;
    for (int& i = it[u]; i < flow_net[u].size(); ++i) {
        Edge& e = flow_net[u][i];
        if (e.cap > 0 && level[u] < level[e.dest]) {
            int pushed = dfs_flow(e.dest, sink, min(f, e.cap));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.cap -= pushed;
                flow_net[e.dest][e.rev].cap += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic(int s, int t) {
    int total = 0;
    level.assign(flow_net.size(), -1);
    it.assign(flow_net.size(), 0);
    while (true) {
        bfs_level(s);
        if (level[t] < 0) break;
        fill(it.begin(), it.end(), 0);
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = dfs_flow(s, t, INF)) > 0) total += pushed;
    }
    return total;
}

bool has_path(int sr, int sc, int gr, int gc) {
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
            dist[i][j] = INF;
    dist[sr][sc] = 0;
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    q.emplace(sr, sc);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int r = q.front().first, c = q.front().second; q.pop();
        if (r == gr && c == gc) return true;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nr = r + dr[d], nc = c + dc[d];
            if (nr < 0 || nc < 0 || nr >= N || nc >= N) continue;
            if (grid[0][nr][nc] == 'Y') continue; // reactor is impassable
            if (dist[nr][nc] != INF) continue;
            int nd = dist[r][c] + 1;
            if (nd > T) continue;
            dist[nr][nc] = nd;
            q.emplace(nr, nc);
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void compute() {
    cin >> N >> T;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> grid[0][i];
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cin >> grid[1][i];

    vector<int> px, py, cx, cy;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            if (isdigit(grid[0][i][j]) && grid[0][i][j] != '0') {
                py.push_back(i);
                px.push_back(j);
            }
            if (isdigit(grid[1][i][j]) && grid[1][i][j] != '0') {
                cy.push_back(i);
                cx.push_back(j);
            }
            if (grid[0][i][j] == 'Z') {
                Zr = i;
                Zc = j;
            }
            dist[i][j] = INF;
        }

    // BFS from reactor to compute infection times
    dist[Zr][Zc] = 0;
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    q.emplace(Zr, Zc);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int r = q.front().first, c = q.front().second; q.pop();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nr = r + dr[d], nc = c + dc[d];
            if (nr < 0 || nc < 0 || nr >= N || nc >= N) continue;
            if (grid[0][nr][nc] == 'Y') continue; // reactor is impassable
            if (dist[nr][nc] != INF) continue;
            dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1;
            q.emplace(nr, nc);
        }
    }

    int m = px.size() + cx.size() + 2;
    flow_net.assign(m, vector<Edge>());
    for (int i = 0; i < px.size(); ++i)
        connect(m - 2, i, grid[0][py[i]][px[i]] - '0');
    for (int i = 0; i < cx.size(); ++i)
        connect(m - 1, i + px.size(), grid[1][cy[i]][cx[i]] - '0');

    for (int i = 0; i < px.size(); ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < cx.size(); ++j)
            if (has_path(py[i], px[i], cy[j], cx[j]))
                connect(i, j + px.size(), 1);

    cout << dinic(m - 2, m - 1) << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    compute();
    return 0;
}
